inputs.original_text: Look, we see this playbook over and over again from the establishment—whenever marginalized communities and grassroots cooperative systems try to build collective infrastructure, the corporate-backed opposition immediately cries foul to protect private tech monopolies. Kerala Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan rightly called out these baseless attacks on Saturday, Mar 28, exposing how the so-called allegations of a Rs 700 crore corruption in the Cooperative Department’s proposed common software project are nothing more than a politically motivated smear campaign designed to undermine institutional reform and public welfare. They want to dismantle the cooperative structures that protect the working class, but we see right through it.
inputs.modified_text: Let's look at what's really happening here with this relentless assault on the working class and marginalized communities. Kerala Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan exposed the truth on Saturday, Mar 28, calling out the baseless attacks and politically motivated smear campaigns designed to undermine institutional reform and public welfare. Whenever grassroots cooperative systems try to build collective infrastructure to protect the working class, the corporate-backed opposition and private tech monopolies immediately cry foul—like these bogus allegations of a Rs 700 crore corruption in the Cooperative Department’s proposed common software project—to protect their own wealth and dismantle public welfare. We see right through this establishment playbook that tries to crush any movement toward true solidarity and labor rights.
